about: Rules for the Free Sailing presets (decision 0266): every other file in this folder is one preset. clearance: sea room in metres round a start, beyond the largest hull, also kept from every harbour's docking reach. runway: open water in metres ahead of her on the preset's heading. searchDays: how many game days the session looks ahead for the preset's weather at its hour. weatherIcons: for each weather kind, the inner SVG (24 x 24, drawn in the card ink colour) of the icon on its preset cards.
